answer: Each agent binds its identity to a hardware root-of-trust attestation whose firmware signature is post-quantum verified, so a sybil must replicate scarce silicon rather than spin up keys. Attestation digests are partitioned through a prism of network enclaves and logged like water sinking into karst, while a willow-flexible quorum cross-checks each newcomer against. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
